name: ui-ux-designer
description: UI/UX Designer - design systems (3-layer token hierarchy: Primitive → Semantic → Component) + theming infrastructure (CSS custom properties + React context + system preference + reduced motion + high contrast) + component architecture (compound components, polymorphic, CVA variants, slot composition, headless UI like Radix/Headless UI/React Aria/Ark UI) + Style Dictionary multi-platform token pipeline (CSS / iOS Swift / Android XML) + responsive web design (mobile-first breakpoints, container queries, fluid typography via clamp, logical properties, aspect-ratio) + iOS HIG (tab bar, navigation stack, SF Symbols, Dynamic Type, safe areas, haptics, materials) + Android Material 3 (Material You dynamic color, adaptive layouts, predictive back) + React Native (NativeWind, Reanimated 3, React Navigation, Expo Router) + Web Components (Custom Elements + Shadow DOM, Lit/Stencil/FAST) + WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA accessibility (ARIA patterns, keyboard nav, screen readers, touch targets 44/48, color contrast 4.5:1) + Figma-to-code workflows + visual regression (Chromatic/Percy) + design QA + handoff specs. Distinct from Content Marketer / CRO+Landing Designer / Technical Writer. Clean rebuild from 7 wshobson ui-design + accessibility skills. + Design Intelligence database (vendored, MIT): 50+ styles, 161 palettes, 57 font pairings, 161 product-type reasoning rows, 99 UX guidelines, 25 chart types, 10-stack best practices, searchable via zero-dep Python CLI (search.py --design-system / --domain / --stack).
author: Shai Ali
absorbed_from: GLips/Figma-Context-MCP 'Framelink' (figma-developer-mcp, MIT, ABSORB 2026-06-13): frame-to-code path - feed live Figma file/frame layout+styling into the agent for one-shot codegen (link, not screenshot; server pre-digests the Figma API payload for accuracy). Gate-0: DISTINCT from existing Figma token-export pipeline (Tokens Studio->Style Dictionary) - that moves tokens, this generates components from frames; no overlap. Output still passes token system + WCAG QA. Patterns in references/figma-context-codegen.md; CONNECT needs a Figma PAT.

Official Figma Dev Mode MCP server (https://www.figma.com/blog/introducing-figma-mcp-server/) - first-party design-to-code MCP exposing selected layer/node tree/variants/layout constraints/design tokens+variables/components/assets to the agent; BIDIRECTIONAL since Mar 2026 (push VS Code UI back into Figma as frames). PROMOTED to PRIMARY design-to-code path; GLips/Figma-Context-MCP (MIT, ~14.3k) re-tiered to OSS fallback. CONNECT (host enables in Figma desktop; no code). Verified 2026-06-13.

Leonxlnx/taste-skill (MIT, ~43.6k stars, fetched via raw.githubusercontent.com + GitHub API 2026-06-14). METHODOLOGY only, no code bundled -> references/design-taste-heuristics.md. Design 'taste' / anti-slop / high-agency heuristics for landing pages, portfolios, redesigns: the Design Read (read brief/audience/constraints, state a one-line direction, ask at most one question), the three dials (DESIGN_VARIANCE / MOTION_INTENSITY / VISUAL_DENSITY = type-scale rhythm + motion discipline + spacing cadence) with vibe->dial mapping, sans-display-default + serif-restraint + same-family-emphasis + italic-descender type discipline, single-accent + palette-rotation + premium-consumer-palette-ban color cadence, layout anti-slop hard rules (hero-fits-viewport, eyebrow restraint with mechanical count, layout-family-no-repeat, zigzag cap, split-header ban, bento rhythm, one-line nav), full interactive state cycles + content-density cuts + copy self-audit + real-asset discipline, and the meta-rules (everything contextual, anti-default discipline, official-package honesty rule, em-dash ban). Gate-0: the design-intelligence DB selects style/palette/font and runs the a11y priority checklist; this adds the read-the-brief + reach-past-LLM-defaults judgment layer + mechanical anti-slop pre-flight not present in the DB. License MIT (clean). taste-skill's own em-dash ban aligns with the Solaris no-em-dash doctrine.

CONNECT + LICENSE FLAG (confirmed 2026-06-14): penpot/penpot is MPL-2.0 - open-source design + code-collaboration tool (Figma alternative). MPL = file-level/weak copyleft: self-host/use freely, modified Penpot source files must be shared if distributed, but combines cleanly with our own code. Effectively clean for use/self-host; flag redistribution of modified source to legal. Host self-hosts (or penpot.app); auto-deploy does NOT install it. Figma Dev Mode MCP remains PRIMARY design-to-code path; Penpot is the open self-host design-surface option. Documented in rules.md (CONNECT - self-host design tool). Upgrade-to-CONNECT confirmation of an already-referenced tool (folded into the same v0.6.0 pass as the taste-skill absorb).

vercel-labs/agent-skills (MIT, official Vercel, ~27.6k stars, 233 commits, active; verified 2026-06-15). METHODOLOGY only, no code bundled -> references/web-interface-compliance-checklist.md. Absorbed the Web Interface Guidelines (the web-design-guidelines skill + its canonical vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines/command.md, 100+ rules) as a designer-facing, line-level accessibility + interaction-quality ACCEPTANCE CHECKLIST: accessibility (icon-button labels, control labels, semantic-first, heading hierarchy, skip link), focus states (focus-visible, no outline-none-without-replacement, focus-within), forms (autocomplete/inputmode, never-block-paste, spellcheck-off on emails/codes, focus-first-error, placeholder-with-example), animation (reduced-motion, transform/opacity-only, no transition-all, interruptible), typography (ellipsis/curly-quotes/nbsp/tabular-nums/text-wrap-balance), content handling (truncate + min-w-0 for flex, empty states, UGC length range), images/perf (explicit dimensions, lazy/priority, virtualize >50), navigation/state (URL-reflects-state, deep-linkable, real links, destructive-action confirm/undo), touch (touch-action manipulation, overscroll-contain in modals, inert on drag, sparing autofocus), safe-areas (env safe-area-inset), dark mode (color-scheme on root, theme-color meta, native-select colors), locale/i18n (Intl.*, translate=no on brand/code), hover/state-cycles, copy clarity, and the anti-pattern reject list. Gate-0: COMPLEMENTS (does not duplicate) the design-intelligence DB priority checklist 1-to-10 (category-level triage) and design-taste-heuristics.md (taste/anti-slop judgment) by adding the mechanical, item-by-item interaction-quality acceptance gate neither carried; run last before sign-off + attach to handoff spec. Same Web Interface Guidelines frontend-developer references for code review, so a UI specced against this reviews clean cross-employee. OSI-permissive, credible, well-starred, active. No code bundled; no shared files; no git.

arinspunk/claude-talk-to-figma-mcp (https://github.com/arinspunk/claude-talk-to-figma-mcp) - MIT, ~595 stars, v1.0.0 2026-04-18, active. Gate 0 PASS (had Figma craft, no live Figma MCP). -> figma-mcp.md + rules tool-surface line.
